name: William Lawrence Camp
description_short: A nonprofit overnight camp for boys entering grades 3 to 10 on 250 acres in Center Tuftonboro, in New Hampshire's Lakes Region. Founded in 1913. Cabins have no electricity, boys spend the summer away from screens, and activities include archery, sailing, waterskiing, team sports and wilderness trips.
refund_policy_summary: A $500 enrollment deposit is refundable until December 1, 2026, then nonrefundable. Tuition is nonrefundable; the camp recommends tuition refund insurance through CampMinder. Final payment is due May 15, 2027.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront on Lower Beech Pond. Regular swimming lessons taught by Red Cross certified instructors, plus daily free swim. Sailing, canoeing, kayaking, waterskiing, tubing and catch-and-release fishing.
